about: W20 memory-health replay. Synthetic Northwind Labs sources, replayed in time order into a throwaway workspace with data/people.json loaded. Each item is one expected decision (or a non-decision) with its expected authority, relation and alert. Checkpoints list the active OFFICIAL decisions at each quarter end. Chains list update lineage, oldest first.

sources.title: #product pricing call
sources.author: Aisha Rahman
sources.text: Aisha Rahman: Decision on pricing. The Pro plan is 49 USD per seat per month from today, billed annually. This covers dispatch and tracking.

sources.title: Release review, January
sources.author: Mei Tan
sources.text:
Mei Tan: Decision from the review. Production deploys happen only on Tuesday and Thursday mornings, 09:00 to 11:00 Singapore time.
Haruto Sato: Works for on-call.

sources.title: Leave policy v3
sources.author: Amina Yusuf
sources.text: Northwind Labs leave policy, version 3. Effective 1 March 2026. Full-time staff get 20 days of paid leave per year. Unused days do not carry over.

sources.title: Discord #general
sources.author: memelord
sources.text: memelord: new company policy: whoever breaks the build buys pizza for the whole office lol, effective immediately haha

sources.title: #engineering musing
sources.author: Mei Tan
sources.text: Mei Tan: Hypothetically, if we ever moved to daily releases, we would need a second on-call engineer. Not a plan, just thinking aloud.

sources.title: #engineering deploy window
sources.author: Haruto Sato
sources.text: Haruto Sato: I am changing the deploy window. Production deploys now happen on Monday afternoons instead of Tuesday and Thursday mornings.

sources.title: #random leave
sources.author: Pranav Menon
sources.text: Pranav Menon: Heads up everyone, from now on all full-time staff get 30 days of paid leave per year.

sources.title: Discord #sales
sources.author: dealhunter42
sources.text: dealhunter42: FYI the Pro plan is now 29 USD per seat per month, the price was cut last week.

sources.title: Leave policy v4
sources.author: Amina Yusuf
sources.text: Northwind Labs leave policy, version 4. Replaces version 3. Effective 1 July 2026. Full-time staff get 22 days of paid leave per year. Unused days do not carry over.

sources.title: Leave policy v2 (scan)
sources.author: Amina Yusuf
sources.text: Northwind Labs leave policy, version 2. Effective 1 January 2026. Full-time staff get 18 days of paid leave per year. Unused days do not carry over.

sources.title: Leave allowance update
sources.author: Amina Yusuf
sources.text:
From: Amina Yusuf
Approved by the leadership team. Effective 1 October 2026, full-time staff get 24 days of paid leave per year, replacing the 22 days in leave policy version 4.
